concepts.meaning: Exact typed argument and Event input bindings for one authored Operation occurrence, pinned to its checked action definition.
The declared result of one committed forward occurrence, available only in its lawful source prefix.
An explicit whole Event constructor envelope, retaining its source-bound Event identity rather than masquerading as a domain record.
The completed forward prefix guaranteed when the compensated occurrence completed; not a promise that compensation executes.

distinctions: call identity is not Operation identity
ordinary input is not Event constructor input
successful result is not failure outcome
compensation dependency is not value availability
signature checking is not provider execution
graph coverage is not recovery policy
